tools.name: toggl_get_me
tools.description: Return the account behind the API token: id, email, full name, default workspace id and timezone. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me.

tools.name: toggl_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces the user belongs to, with id, name and organization id. Call this first to find the workspace_id the other tools need. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me/workspaces.

tools.name: toggl_get_workspace_statistics
tools.description: Return the statistics of one workspace: its counts of users, projects and similar totals. Counts against the workspace quota. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/statistics.

tools.name: toggl_list_time_entries
tools.description: List the user's time entries between two timestamps, as an array of entries (id, workspace id, project id, start, stop, duration in seconds, description, tags). The API returns at most 1000 entries. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me/time_entries.

tools.name: toggl_get_current_time_entry
tools.description: Return the time entry that is running now, or null when nothing runs. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me/time_entries/current.

tools.name: toggl_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects of one workspace, with id, name, client, active flag and billable flag. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/projects.

tools.name: toggl_get_project
tools.description: Return one project of a workspace by id. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: toggl_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags the user can attach to time entries. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me/tags.

tools.name: toggl_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients the user can assign to projects. Counts against the user's 30 requests per hour. Toggl Track API: GET /api/v9/me/clients.

tools.name: toggl_start_time_entry
tools.description: Start a running time entry in a workspace now. Check toggl_get_current_time_entry first and stop any running entry. Stop this one with toggl_stop_time_entry. Toggl Track API: POST /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/time_entries with duration -1.

tools.name: toggl_stop_time_entry
tools.description: Stop a running time entry. Stopping an entry that already stopped returns an error. Toggl Track API: PATCH /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/time_entries/{time_entry_id}/stop.

tools.name: toggl_create_time_entry
tools.description: Add a finished time entry with a start time and a duration in seconds. Toggl computes the stop time. Each call creates a new entry. Toggl Track API: POST /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/time_entries.

tools.name: toggl_create_project
tools.description: Create a project in a workspace. Toggl Track API: POST /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/projects.

tools.name: toggl_create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag in a workspace. Toggl Track API: POST /api/v9/workspaces/{workspace_id}/tags.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: toggl_get_me, toggl_start_time_entry · Private data: toggl_get_me · Public sink: toggl_get_me, toggl_start_time_entry, toggl_create_time_entry, toggl_create_project, toggl_create_tag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: toggl_get_me, toggl_start_time_entry · Private data: toggl_get_me · Public sink: toggl_get_me, toggl_start_time_entry, toggl_create_time_entry, toggl_create_project, toggl_create_tag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
